additional_info.body:
Bom dia Srs.
Espero que todos estejam bem!
@Pinto, Joao Paulo De Camargo Torres
, estamos com uma falha no carregador Y2 R4 313020197004 – Shell Recharge l Posto Saci, notei que a estação está com várias recargas que iniciam e no máximo após 2 minutos se encerra automaticamente.  Solicito por gentileza uma abertura de chamado para verificar a possível falha e resolução do problema.
Notei algumas falhas como erro InternalError como pode ser analisado abaixo.
[23-01-2025 13:38:46,070] [CPSHELL068]: [CPSHELL068] | # Received -> [2,"0c2fc850-e56f-4ac2-80d3-001336e53e32","StatusNotification",{"connectorId":1,"errorCode":"InternalError","status":"Faulted"}]

Att.

additional_info.body:
Good morning gentlemen.
I hope everyone is well!
@Pinto, Joao Paulo De Camargo Torres, we are experiencing a failure in the Y2 R4 313020197004 charger – Shell Recharge l Posto Saci, I noticed that the station is having several recharges that start and after a maximum of 2 minutes it ends automatically. I kindly request that you open a ticket to check the possible failure and resolve the problem.
I noticed some errors like InternalError as can be analyzed below.
[2025-01-23 13:38:46,070] [CPSHELL068]: [CPSHELL068] | # Received -> [2,"0c2fc850-e56f-4ac2-80d3-001336e53e32","StatusNotification",{"connectorId":1,"errorCode":"InternalError","status":"Faulted"}]

additional_info.subject: RE: ID0402044-DC/Si-D/BR-[Y2 / R3 313020197004] Internal error CRM:01811000625
additional_info.body:
Hello Rafael,
I hope you're doing well.
We have reviewed the logs from the provided timestamp, and as per our findings, the charging sessions on 23rd January faced failures due to issues on the EV side.
Specifically, out of 8 charging sessions, 6 failures were related to the EV side, while 2 failures were attributed to authentication errors.
Additionally, we have requested the expert team to provide us with more detailed logs for further investigation.
In the recent logs, we observed that the failures were related to an
ERR_EVCOM
(EV communication problem) as per the error message detected.
We will continue to monitor and analyze the logs to find a resolution.
Please feel free to reach out if you have any further questions or need additional information.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Ankita Khobare
